prompt: Red finds a lost puppy in the park
title: Lost Puppy Home
irony: Red finds a lost puppy to keep, but only by giving it back does she keep its love.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Red and Green find a tiny shivering puppy under the street lamp at night.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Red wants to keep the puppy and stuffs it fast in a cardboard box by the curb.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Black jumps out, claims the puppy is his and dares Red to prove it is hers.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The whole street gathers round the lamp and sings the lost-puppy call together.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Red lures the puppy with a treat by the old gate, but it snatches the treat and bolts.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: The muddy puppy shakes all over Green by the pumpkins, chews Red's shoe and yips.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: Back under the street lamp, the friends sing the lost-puppy call louder together.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: White kneels by the lamp, holds the puppy close while Navy watches softly.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: White decides to knock door to door to find the puppy's home as Red and Navy nod.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: White lifts the puppy high and sings the turned line that giving back keeps love.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Red waves as the puppy trots home to Silver, lamp glow warm over the street.
